confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cusco's tourist-area prices, not from live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and varies widely by neighbourhood. July is high season, so accommodation anchors reflect peak-dry-season rates. Cocktail and wine are estimated from beer using the local price relationship (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.6x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from a search results summary that cites rba.gov.au pages; I did not open the RBA page or the F11 table directly, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Andean highland tourist-city pattern in Peru (e.g., Arequipa, plus tourist districts of Lima), adjusted upward for Cusco's concentrated visitor demand around the historic centre and San Blas. Accommodation anchors assume the central and San Blas areas visitors use.
